panel.title: Kis Segítő
language.name: English
settings.title: Settings
settings.language_hint: Used on the knobs and in this panel.
common.confirm_delete: Delete this? Token history is kept.
common.name: Name
children.color_warning: This colour is close to a time-zone colour (green, orange, red, gold); it may be harder to tell apart on the knob.
children.knob_hint: A child belongs to at most one knob. On a knob with assigned children only they can be selected; the others are shown locked. A knob without children (or with every child) works for everyone.
routines.zones_hint: The whole colour structure is visible on the knob from the start; each zone starts this many minutes before the end.
routines.base_color: Time track base colour (on the knob)
routines.checkpoints_hint: Timed targets. Shared ones are on the outer track, child-specific ones on the inner track. Finishing a checkpoint's tasks completes it; the reward depends on how early.
routines.bands: Reward by time: at least … minutes early → tokens (the best matching band counts)
tokens.hint: Positive numbers add tokens, negative ones subtract. Everything is recorded in the history and can be reversed there.
history.confirm_reverse: Reverse this transaction? A compensating entry is added; nothing is deleted.
settings.no_knobs: No knob added yet (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Kis Segítő).
settings.knobs_hint: The avatars show which children belong to each knob; set it on the child's page.
settings.knob_new_key_confirm: Give this knob a new picture key? The old key stops working at once; the knob gets the new one automatically.
settings.knob_unencrypted: This knob is not encrypted: it shows no uploaded pictures until you set an API encryption key for it (see Repairs).
error.zero_amount: The amount must not be zero.
modify.title: Modify today
modify.hint: Changes here apply to today only; the routines themselves stay as they are. Every change is logged.
calendar.hint: Routines as they run each day; orange blocks are changed for that day only.
notifications.hint: Each rule sends a message through a Home Assistant notify target (e.g. the companion app) for the chosen events and children. For your own automations every event is also available as kis_segito_event.
settings.inactivity: Back to the child selector after (seconds without use)
settings.export_hint: Downloads every setting and the full token history as one JSON file.
panel.outdated: Kis Segítő was updated: reload the page to use the new version.
templates.title: Day templates
templates.hint: A day template says which routines run on a day (e.g. Weekday, Weekend, Holiday). Choose a default for each weekday; a single date can be changed on the Today page. Days without a template use each routine's own days.
templates.routines: Routines on this kind of day
picture.title: Picture
picture.hint: An uploaded photo is shown in the panel and, once downloaded, on the knob; otherwise the icon.
picture.failed: The picture could not be uploaded.
notifications.fixed_values: Fixed values for the other fields (e.g. recipient):
notifications.label: Label of notification scripts
notifications.label_missing: No Home Assistant label with this name yet.
notifications.label_hint: Give your notification scripts this label (Settings → Automations & scenes → Scripts → Labels); only they are offered as targets.
calendar.hint_edit: Click a routine to change it for that day only, drag it to move it (or its top/bottom edge to change the start/end), click an empty place to add a routine for that day. Dashed border: changed for that day; dotted with stripes: one-day routine. Past days are read-only.
day.title: Only for
day.hint: Changes here apply to this date only; the routine itself stays as it is. Sections marked ✎ differ from the routine. Everything is logged.
day.readonly: This day is in the past; it can only be viewed.
routines.color_hint: Only for the calendar views. The colours on the knob's time track are set under Time colours below.
routines.color_similar: Another routine has a very similar colour.
scope.title: Change which?
scope.hint: This occurrence only changes this one day; the whole series changes the routine itself on every day.
background.title: Background
background.hint: Shown on every knob, for every child. Changing it restarts the knobs once to show the new picture.
screen.title: Knob screen
screen.hint: Idle times for every knob; 0 = never. The screensaver shows bouncing balls, confetti or stars; with drawing off the screen goes black and stops drawing. Any turn or press wakes the knob.
screen.own_hint: Empty fields use the general values above.
rtemplates.title: Saved routines (templates)
rtemplates.name: Template name
rtemplates.hint: Saves this routine as it is in the form (tasks, order, icons, times, checkpoints) under its own name. A new routine can be created from it later in the routine list, for any children.
